note: Machine-readable copy of the vault's gate criteria. agents/tests/test_vault_sync.py fails if the two drift. Ids never change meaning; retire instead of reusing.

humanCheckpoints.rc: Publish the Saved version (a person does this in Studio or Creator Hub)

criteria.text: Every market claim cites a chart snapshot or source with date and numbers; trend data is no older than 7 days.
The one-sentence loop ("You ___ to get ___ so you can ___") is concrete and playable in Roblox terms.
First 60 seconds, goal at 10-15 minutes, and why-tomorrow are written as player actions.
The twist changes how the game plays compared with named comparables.
Urgency read (early or late) with comparable counts and trend phase.
Checked against our portfolio: not a duplicate of something we ship.
Audience tier, content rating expectation and IP risks are stated.
Rubric score with justifications (Pitch and greenlight).
Moment, session and long loops written; seven loop tests planned (Core loop design).
First-session timeline with targets per phase (First session blueprint).
Economy sheet for three player types; time-to-goal for the first five goals; first goal at 10-15 minutes for a casual free player.
Drop tables with designed time-to-see per tier, luck stacking rule and caps (if randomness exists).
Return systems specified: daily reward, streak or equivalent, daily quests, at least one next-day timer; or an argued omission.
Social reason specified (co-play bonus, co-op, competition) or an argued omission.
Product catalog draft mapped to motivations and price tiers, passing the fairness table.
Art direction one-pager with palette, shapes, references; icon concept.
Build brief can be executed without further design decisions; open questions listed.
Reused systems and assets from our library identified by id.
Core action playable with juice layers 1-4 (Game feel and juice).
Seven loop tests reported with evidence.
Newcomer playtest: core action performed within 30 seconds without reading.
Fun verdict and recommendation: continue, pivot or stop, with reasons.
The place builds from source (`rojo build` exits successfully).
Format, lint and type checks clean (StyLua, Selene, luau-lsp analyze).
Unit tests pass for economy math, drop tables, validators, migrations and receipts.
All remotes go through the Net module with validators and rate limits; no raw remotes elsewhere.
No currency, rewards, damage or prices decided on the client.
Data: session locking, `UpdateAsync`, autosave, leave and shutdown saves, failed-load kick, schema version.
`ProcessReceipt` idempotent with receipt history; saves before acknowledging.
Analytics: onboarding funnel, economy events and minimum event plan implemented.
All tunables and new features behind config with validated defaults.
Game identity set (name, config ids, theme) instead of template defaults.
Paid random items: odds displays, boosts reflected, `PolicyService` gates.
Every non-owned asset scanned and recorded in the asset index with source and license.
The build report matches reality: three sampled brief requirements verified in a playtest.
Golden-path test passes in Studio, with screenshots.
Device checks at phone, tablet and desktop; no overlap with platform controls.
Low-end performance: no stutter at spawn; memory stable over 30 minutes.
Juice pass done; rarest outcomes clearly more exciting than common ones.
Economy balance pass: measured playtest times match the economy sheet within agreed tolerance, or the sheet is updated.
Icon 512×512 and at least three distinct thumbnails at 1920×1080, reviewed at phone size, honest to gameplay.
Title, description and genre written per Titles and descriptions.
Nothing has been published by automation; the candidate is a Saved version.
Security review complete (Security and anti-exploit checklist).
Compliance review complete (Monetization compliance checklist); questionnaire answers drafted for the human.
All prior approvals refer to the exact build being shipped (version or hash).
No open waivers, or each listed for explicit human acceptance.
Launch plan and rollback plan written (Launch playbook).
Each change in an experiment or update names one primary variable and a pre-registered hypothesis with expected direction.
Measurement window stated in UTC; confounders (ads, events, holidays) declared.
Fix attempts on a failing metric capped (for example two) before escalating to redesign.
Every outcome number cites source and date range.
Verdicts only on measured metrics; refuted and inconclusive results recorded fully.
No lesson promoted to a house rule with fewer than three confirming cases.
